ModulePrefs.title: AtwoodMachine2wee
ModulePrefs.author: Lee Tat Leong slightly remixed by lookang (weelookang@gmail.com); weelookang@gmail.com
ModulePrefs.description:
This simulation is to recreate Walter Fendt's Newton's Second Law applet (http://www.walter-fendt.de/ph14e/n2law.htm). The purpose is to align with Modelling Instructions approach to formulate F = ma with experiment conducted with motion sensor rather than light gate.
http://weelookang.blogspot.sg/2013/04/ejs-open-source-modified-atwood-machine.html
Investigate the relation between the mass and the acceleration of the system keep the external force (hanging mass) constant add mass to the cart
